name: Conventions Extractor — accept/reject/edit the seeded candidates, then create + link a skill
description: Cannot run extract in e2e (no LLM key, no clone — specs/conventions-extractor.md §9); the seed instead adds one scan + 3 pending candidates on acme/payments-api (highest-confidence first: error-handling, imports, naming). This flow edits the first candidate then rejects it (collapses to one line with Undo), accepts the second (toolbar count updates, Create skill appears — C16), opens Create skill (prefilled from skill-draft, C14), attaches the Security Reviewer agent, submits, and follows the deep-link to that agent's Skills tab (C13) where the new `repo-conventions` skill is now linked. Creates real data — run last, and only against the hermetic stack (a fresh DB per run).
